records.subject: Still want to get Timber Works set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

Ahmed

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Customer replied engaged and said setup is 'on our list this week' [email:fad7df7e], and is on an active Team plan with 8 days left. But at day 6 nothing started: no project, no invite [email:5e378ba0], and two prior nudges [email:5a35bbd5, email:3a862562] went unacted on, so intent is stated but unproven.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Timber Works' setup
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for the update — totally understandable that getting everyone set up takes a little time.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the quickest thing to stand up. And if it's easier, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project and invites with you so your team can pick it up from there.

Best,
Chidi
